english: Which church's calendar the wheel follows
All: every commemoration. Festivals: the festivals and feasts (in the Roman calendar, solemnities and feasts). Principal: only the principal days (solemnities). None: the saints' days are left off.
translation: Alle: hver minnedag. Høytider: høytidene og helligdagene (i den romerske kalenderen høytider og fester). Bare hovedhøytider: bare hovedhøytidene (høytider). Ingen: helgendagene utelates.

english: Which calendar the dates are reckoned in
How Easter is dated, which is a separate question from how the days are named. Left to follow the calendar, a Gregorian wheel keeps Western Easter and the other two keep the Eastern one.
translation: Hvordan påsken dateres, som er et annet spørsmål enn hvordan dagene navngis. Følger den kalenderen, beholder et gregoriansk hjul den vestlige påsken og de to andre den østlige.

english: Name the one-year Sundays as the historic calendar does, from the first words of the day's Introit: Ad Te Levavi, Laetare, Quasimodo Geniti
